people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Ahithophel
people.line: David's counselor who joined Absalom's rebellion, later committed suicide

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: Someone told David, saying, “Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom.” David said, “Yahweh, please turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness.”
translations.bsb: Now someone told David: “Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom.” So David pleaded, “O LORD, please turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness!”
translations.kjv: And one told David, saying, Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom. And David said, O LORD, I pray thee, turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness.
translations.asv: And one told David, saying, Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom. And David said, O Jehovah, I pray thee, turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness.
